note: Provenance for the landing page's product material. Staleness in a screenshot is invisible in review — the old gallery shipped a v0.0.42beta window with an empty Mission Board and a stray text selection for weeks. Recording what each asset was captured from makes the gap a fact instead of an impression. test/lander-assets.test.ts asserts this file and the directory agree. The landing page no longer carries a screenshot gallery; the two files left are referenced by README.md only.

refresh.gallery: Run the desktop app on the target release, drive it to the state each shot describes, and capture the window. Shots must show real work, not an empty state.
refresh.conceptFlow: qa/record-real-client-demo.ps1 records the desktop window against a live task, then qa/curate-client-demo.mjs edits the frames into the GIF.
